extraction.summary_en: This filing bundles two PVs of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES: an AGO of 2 September 2005 (president change only, no capital effect) and an AGE of 8 August 2005 that ratifies a share-transfer protocol under which Malik GUELLATI, Christophe LEROUX and Marielle ROUJEAN sell all their shares, resulting in a new distribution among Antonio BLANCO MARINA, Xavier AUMONT and Franck GICQUEL for the full 1500 shares (capital unchanged at 150,000 euros). The registry labels mention an 'Augmentation du capital social' and updated statutes, but no corresponding text appears in the OCR provided, so no capital-increase detail can be extracted from this excerpt.

snapshots.as_of_basis: Répartition résultant des ordres de mouvement à émettre en date du 16 août 2005, ratifiée à l'AGE du 8 août 2005.

evidence.quote_fr: Il en résulte au terme des ordres de mouvement à émettre en date du 16 août 2005, la nouvelle répartition suivante entre les associés : Antonio BLANCO 823 actions 54,87 % ... Xavier AUMONT 617 actions 41,13 % ... Franck GICQUEL 60 actions 6,00 %

issues: The registry labels list 'Augmentation du capital social' and 'Statuts mis à jour' as parts of this filing, but no OCR text corresponding to a capital increase or updated statutes was provided in this document; only the AGO (2 Sept 2005) and AGE (8 Aug 2005) minutes appear, so no capital-increase event could be extracted here.

The percentages printed in the répartition table (54.87% + 41.13% + 6.00% = 102%) do not sum to 100%; based on the share counts (823+617+60=1500) the correct percentage for Franck GICQUEL should be 4.00%, suggesting an OCR/typographical error in the '6,00 %' figure.

The document states the aggregate result of the share transfer (823/617/60 split among BLANCO, AUMONT, GICQUEL) but does not specify which buyer acquired shares from which of the three sellers, so no individual SHAREHOLDER_SHARE_TRANSFER pairs could be recorded; only the resulting SHAREHOLDER_END for the three sellers and the post-transfer snapshot are recorded.

The 'accord entre ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES et ARCHEAN INTERNATIONAL' ratified in the third resolution (p6.10-12, p7.2-4) is mentioned without any detail on its content; it is out of scope as no capital or shareholding effect is stated.
